description: Gives people access to a site (owner). editor: invites a collaborator (on a workspace site a Workspace Member, a seat, maybe after the Workspace Owner approves). viewer: that site only, no seat. workspace_visitor: views every site of the workspace, read-only, no seat. visitor: emails or domains (acme.com) for an invite-only site. Returns approve_url for the approval.

confirm_token.description: From the first call: re-call with it (site only) for the approval status

emails.description: Email addresses; for visitor also company domains, e.g. acme.com (required unless confirm_token)

notify.description: visitor: email each new address (default true)

role.description: Required unless confirm_token. An audience (students, clients) is visitor (an invited visitor): sees only the invite-only site. viewer is a collaborator: also sees versions and people. workspace_visitor: views every site of the workspace in the app, read-only

name: add_people
title: Add people
